title: Dwelling addresses the street
text: The dwelling is to address the street (including a battleaxe driveway, communal street or right-of-way where this is the primary frontage) in accordance with the following: i. the primary entrance to the dwelling must be readily identifiable from the street; and ii. provide at least one major opening on the dwelling frontage with an outlook to the street.

parts.label: (i) primary entrance readily identifiable from the street
(ii) at least one major opening on the frontage with outlook to the street

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Both limbs required. 'Habitable room' qualifier on the major opening is dropped from the current code; Part B ancillary dwelling exemption not carried (see 2.8). Street includes a battleaxe driveway, communal street or ROW where that is the primary frontage.
